title: Add support for WebSocket connections in API Gateway
body:
We need to add WebSocket support to our API Gateway to enable real-time communication for our chat feature.

## Requirements
- Support WebSocket upgrade requests
- Handle connection lifecycle (connect, disconnect, reconnect)
- Implement heartbeat mechanism
- Add proper error handling and logging

## Technical Details
- Use ws library for Node.js
- Integrate with existing authentication middleware
- Add metrics and monitoring

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] WebSocket connections can be established
- [ ] Messages can be sent and received
- [ ] Connections are properly cleaned up on disconnect
- [ ] Comprehensive tests are added
